purpose: Machine-readable portfolio architecture registry for AI agents coordinating four related data-engineering products.

source_of_truth.implementation_truth: Each product's code repository and current tests
source_of_truth.rule: Never infer that target_state is implemented. Inspect the owning repository before coding or reporting completion.

products.name: Zilla / CaseLab
products.role: Data-engineering take-home and multi-step case simulator

lifecycle.current: source archive/donor exists; canonical product repo not assigned
lifecycle.target: CaseLab product around realistic DE assignments

products.name: Fabric Factory Lab
products.role: Visual Data Factory and pipeline learning environment

lifecycle.current: rich frontend donor exists in Datapass; standalone FastAPI backend exists

products.name: Contoso Data Studio
products.role: Realistic local data-platform construction and exploration

lifecycle.current: canonical repo initialized but mostly empty; generator donor exists
lifecycle.target: generator + DuckLake + dbt + dimensional analytics studio

shared_services.contract: Datapass uses bounded PySpark execution; CaseLab may expose deeper Spark planning/simulation/diagnosis.
Datapass gets compile/validate/DAG preview only; CaseLab gets scheduler-state simulation, retries, trigger rules, failures and timelines.
Owns pipeline definitions, validation, expressions, run history and future local/external activity executors.
